question: Which of the following states was NOT amongst the top three states with highest total percentage of literacy rate, in the 2011 census ?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Tripura**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__
 
• Kerala, with a literacy rate of 93.91%, was the highest amongst all states in the 2011 census.
 
• Goa had a literacy rate of 88.70%, placing it amongst the top three states.
 
• Mizoram had a literacy rate of 91.58%, making it one of the top three states in terms of literacy rate.
 
• Tripura, although having a high literacy rate of 87.22%, was not in the top three states in the 2011 census.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Literacy Rate:**

 
 
• Literacy rate is the percentage of people who are able to read and write with understanding in a specific language.
 
• It is a crucial indicator of socio-economic progress and is used to assess the educational level of a population.
 
• The literacy rate is often calculated for individuals above a certain age, typically 7 years and older, in India.
 
 
 
• **Census:**
 
 
• A census is a systematic collection of data about a population.
 
• In India, the census is conducted every 10 years by the Office of the Registrar General and Census Commissioner under the Ministry of Home Affairs.
 
• The data collected includes demographic, social, and economic information, which is used for policy-making and resource allocation.
 
 
 
• **Top Three States in Literacy Rate (2011 Census):**
 
 
• **Kerala:** With a literacy rate of 93.91%, Kerala had the highest literacy rate in India as per the 2011 census.
 
• **Mizoram:** Mizoram, with a literacy rate of 91.58%, was the second-highest.
 
• **Goa:** Goa had a literacy rate of 88.70%, making it the third-highest in the 2011 census.
 
 
 
• **Importance of Literacy:**
 
 
• Literacy is fundamental for individual and societal development.
 
• It enhances the ability of individuals to engage in economic activities, access healthcare, and participate in civic and political processes.
 
• Higher literacy rates are associated with improved living standards and economic growth.
